forum.title: Identifying Part Number from Marking on Device (L78L15ABUTR)
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome ​@john.sharp, to the community!

In some datasheets, the marking information can indeed be found, and the L78L is one of them. You can therefore find the confirmation in the [datasheet, table 30](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/l78l.pdf): the marking **8L** stands for **L78L15ABUTR**.

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I’m trying to identify the part number of a STMicroelectronics LDO that is on one of our boards to verify it is the correct part through the device marking. I saw on another forum post that the device marking decoding information is something that only STMicroelectronics has access to internally. Could I please get help identifying the part circled in red by it device marking? It looks like it say 8L533. The part is supposed to be L78L15ABUTR.

Thank you,

John Sharp

[Screenshot 2026-06-17 144356.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e48f2f3a-69d5-4647-9802-8b350da6d670.png)
forum.author: john.sharp

scraped_replies.author: Peter BENSCH

scraped_replies.html: Ah I see. Thanks Peter! So are the numbers following 8L just a date code?
scraped_replies.author: john.sharp

scraped_replies.html: Yes, the following characters are the date code: YWW, i.e. last digit of the year and the week number.
